notes:
Short summary / CRM notes:
- Product team (CTO: Anya Rao) evaluating hosted API first (fast dev) with plan to move to Dedicated/VPC for production.
- Primary workload: in-app conversational assistant + embeddings-based search for KB; also occasional reranking and summarization.
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for user-facing chat; throughput target ~120 concurrent sessions, ~50 req/s sustained. Cost sensitivity: wants predictable unit economics; will trade some cost for latency.
- Started hosted API POC 2026-02-01; initial integration looks good, basic prompts + embeddings.
- Demo of Dedicated (reserved capacity) 2026-02-15; liked autoscaling and explicit capacity controls.
- Security review escalated: they require SOC2 report, SSO via SAML, tenant-level audit logs, configurable retention controls, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for subset of traffic.
- Quote from CTO: "We need a clear path to VPC + SAML and strong auditability before we can onboard paying customers."
- Pricing: requested committed monthly pricing for Dedicated (monthly seat/throughput commit). CFO wants firm upper bound on monthly spend for first year.
- Legal asked about retention controls and log export timelines; security ops asked about ability to disable retention for PII.
- Next: exchange SAML metadata (SE + Infra), security team to review SOC2 and the security FAQ drive doc, draft Dedicated SOW and term sheet.
- Risks: procurement timeline depends on SOC2 acceptance + legal redlines on retention; integration work for VPC peering may take 2-3 weeks depending on network config.
- Internal notes: prioritize SSO walkthrough for 2026-03-05 call, provide sample audit log export and retention policy config screenshots.
